name: Compass Made
old_description: Electromechanical contract manufacturer specializing in cable/harness assembly
about:
Compass Made is headquartered in Fremont, California, with additional manufacturing facilities in Deming, New Mexico, and an engineering support center in Juárez, Mexico. The company traces its roots to 1979 when Compass Components, Inc. was founded to provide components, distribution, and assembly services to local customers. Over the decades the business expanded into contract manufacturing and cable and harness assembly, rebranding as Compass Made in 2018 to emphasize its focus on engineered solutions.

Today Compass Made operates as an electromechanical contract manufacturer specializing in cable and wire harness assemblies, electromechanical box builds, and large-scale system integration. The firm employs more than 300 people across its three sites and reports using roughly 15.7 million feet of wire annually while testing over 335,000 circuits each month. Capabilities span design, engineering, prototyping, and full-rate production of harnesses, cables, and integrated assemblies.

The customer base includes industry leaders in transportation, semiconductor equipment, industrial machinery, agriculture, food processing, energy, and robotics. Compass Made also continues to function as a component distribution hub for regional companies, supplementing its contract manufacturing services.

The company cites its corporate values — integrity, respect, accountability, innovation, improvement, and customer focus — as the foundation of its differentiation. Leadership emphasizes that the engineering team is frequently engaged to help customers refine prototypes and improve manufacturability, positioning Compass Made as a solutions-oriented partner rather than a pure build-to-print shop.
